name: Sausage Balls
author: Justin Crawley
steps: Shred 12 oz sharp cheddar into microwave safe bowl
Add in 1 box of cream cheese
Melt together in microwave, stirring frequently until mostly melted
Slowly add 4 cups of bisquick on cup at a time
Add 1/4 cup of milk as needed for consistency
Mix in 2 lbs of sausage thoroughly until solid consistency
Roll mixture into ping pong ball size and place on ungreased baking sheet
Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes until golden brown
